annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 97/68/EC on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directive 97/68/EC on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities C 180 E
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal (COM(2000) 840) amending Directive 97/68/EC to extend emission limits to small spark-ignition (petrol) engines in non-road mobile machinery. It sets two-stage limit values, type-approval rules, test procedures, and a voluntary averaging, banking and trading scheme. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends Directive 97/68/EC to small spark-ignition engines of 19 kW or less in non-road mobile machinery
Sets Stage I and Stage II emission limits (CO, HC+NOx) by engine class, with phase-in dates from 2004 to 2010
Adds a voluntary averaging, banking and trading scheme aligned with US rules (Annex XII)
Requires type-approval and engine labelling, with relaxed deadlines for small-volume manufacturers
Adds spark-ignition test procedures (Annex IV) and moves the committee procedure to Decision 1999/468/EC
